title: 火鍋店等一個人
subject: holding a four-seat hotpot table for someone who is not coming
caption: Mandarin math rock. Two clean electric guitars played with two-handed tapping in shifting odd meters, bright and chiming with no distortion, an agile drum kit playing around the bar line with a lot of ghost notes on the snare, melodic bass moving independently of the guitars rather than following them. Bright and dry with every instrument clearly separated and almost no reverb. Male voice, clipped and syllable-dense, fitting words against an uneven pulse, half-spoken. 150 BPM, G major. Humiliation slowly turning into something funnier. No distortion, no synth, no ballad section, no big chorus, no key change.
lyrics:
[Intro - tapped clean guitar in odd meter]

[Verse 1]
鴛鴦鍋 已經滾了十七分鐘
我點了兩人份 服務生問我「還有一位嗎」
我說「馬上到」 說得很自然
自然到我自己都信了一下

[Pre-Chorus]
手機朝下放著
朝下放著 就不算在等

[Chorus]
湯一直滾 料一直沒下
我把筷子擺正 再擺正 再擺正
這張桌子四個位置 我佔了一個 守了三個
守到我自己都覺得 這個畫面很好笑

[Verse 2]
隔壁桌一群人在鬧 其中一個人看了我一眼
那一眼不是同情 是「喔 有人在等人」
我寧願他同情我
至少那樣 我還可以生氣

[Chorus]
湯還在滾 料還是沒下
我把筷子擺正 再擺正 最後一次
這張桌子四個位置 我佔了一個 守了三個
守到服務生來問我「要不要先幫您關小一點」

[Outro - guitars stop]
我說好
然後我把兩人份 一個人吃完
[Song ends abruptly]
